findings.title: serial_test not a model-provider dev-dep
findings.detail: model-provider/Cargo.toml:42 [dev-dependencies] lacks serial_test; workspace defines it at Cargo.toml:417. Tests using #[serial_test::serial] won't compile. Impl must add serial_test = { workspace = true } first.
findings.resolution: Corrected the constraint, added a US-001 AC and an ordering note; added a Cargo.lock/Bazel-lock nuance.

findings.title: Global-gate set-at-start + serialize existing test
findings.detail: New tests must install_anthropic_gate(false) at start AND end; existing un-serialized cache_identity_tracks_resolved_anthropic_gate (copilot_models_endpoint.rs) flips the global gate and should also be #[serial].

findings.title: US-002 online-branch coverage too weak
findings.detail: A comment/ledger note does not guard copilot.rs:140. Add a static guard in codex/scripts/audit_invariants.sh asserting BOTH wrap sites return GatedModelsManager::wrap(...).
findings.resolution: US-002 now requires a concrete audit_invariants.sh check covering both wrap sites; AC made testable.

findings.title: Nested-repo commit layering under-specified
findings.detail: Code is in the inner submodule; patch-surface.md + audit_invariants.sh are in the codex wrapper; codexu needs the pointer bump. Order must be stated.

findings.title: Invariant 39 update should point to enforcing mechanism
findings.detail: Ledger update should reference audit_invariants.sh + patch-surface.md:877.

findings.title: US-004 ambiguous include/defer
findings.detail: Mark explicitly deferred so the implementer does not expand the ship.
findings.resolution: US-004 relabeled DEFERRED; default impl scope = US-001+US-002+US-003 only.

findings.title: US-001 not a true session/request-boundary lock
findings.detail: US-001 manually replays session/mod.rs's two-step; a future session refactor using config.model directly would still pass. Suggests a core-level handoff guard.
findings.resolution: Documented residual seam in Risk + Open Questions; offered an optional core-level stretch test.

findings.title: ModelInfo has no is_default field
findings.detail: Catalog wording 'gpt-5.5 ... is_default' would cause a compile mistake; defaulting is derived at the ModelPreset level (default_model_from_presets falls back to .first()).
findings.resolution: Reworded catalog ACs to 'gpt-5.5 first/surviving entry'.
